name: Footnote
oneLiner: Source-grounded community notes for Bluesky, with separate evidence and tone judgments, immutable history, writer bonds, and appeals on GenLayer.
description: Footnote adds source-grounded context to public Bluesky posts. GenLayer validators independently judge evidence (Supported, Contradicted, Unsupported, Misleading) and tone. Notes preserves versions; Recheck blocks open appeals before fetching; Appeals judges counter-evidence and cancels stale or timed-out appeals; Bonds holds deposits directly and uses receipt-verified pull withdrawals. Allegations use a stricter two-label rule; names, handles and post text stay off-chain. Reading needs no wallet. StudioNet is a simulator: the public demo deployment uses a 15-minute appeal window; production default is 72 hours. Demo cancellation grace is 10 minutes and bond release delay is 15 minutes. Production cancellation grace is 24 hours. Forced version-drift cancellation and source-change replay are test-only; finalized live receipts show the recorded lifecycle.
expectedOutcome: Help readers inspect what supplied sources establish, separate factual support from provocative tone, and challenge notes with new evidence. Demonstrate four working GenLayer contracts with auditable finality, per-address spam limits, immutable history, and verified native-credit withdrawals. Labels remain judgments about sources, not guarantees of truth.
